subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw ship Anthropic native web search as first-class bundled Anthropic plugin behavior, and what policy should gate server-side search, domain filters, encrypted result replay, and billing/auth visibility?
rationale: The requested provider is technically feasible but changes provider-hosted web access and session/replay semantics, so automation should not choose defaults or security posture without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic native search
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in Anthropic plugin/provider implementation with explicit policy, replay, docs, and tests before accepting a PR.

options.title: Keep only existing managed providers
options.body: Defer Anthropic native search and document Gemini, Perplexity, Brave, and other managed providers as the supported workaround for now.

options.title: Route to external plugin first
options.body: Ask for an external proof-of-concept plugin only if maintainers confirm the current SDK can support the required stream and result semantics without core changes.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic native search
recommendation.body: Add a narrow opt-in Anthropic plugin/provider implementation with explicit policy, replay, docs, and tests before accepting a PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent Anthropic provider/plugin boundary history and prior review context for the related broader server-tools tracker.
